scope: Snapshot conservative source-column deposition on actual frozen grid044 donor plus continuous total source/proper-time quadrature. No per-cell time-history integration, IVP, opacity, chemistry or new source channel.

inputs.identity: Actual model nonbaryonic massive DM moments with gravity already in saved H/shear. Do not import AX03 stress-free background or another thread's source-exchange adapter.

background.reader: Read eta,H,b,s,nH_ref_cm3,proper_elapsed_s from pinnedNPZ. H(eta)=exp(PCHIP(eta_nodes,logH_nodes)); b(eta)=CubicHermiteSpline(eta_nodes,b_nodes-b0,s_nodes/H_nodes); nHref=n0exp(-3eta). Match original Background without instantiating Reduced, RHS or provider.
background.geometry: Normalized coordinate scales Aperp=exp(eta-b),Aparallel=exp(eta+2b), V=exp(3eta). These equal1 at reference eta0. Physical cosmological scale factor a=exp(eta)/21; do not insert21^3 into normalized covariant Jacobian. Proper density nHref comes from donor.
background.clock: eta=ln(a/a_ref),dt/deta=1/H. T(eta)=integral_0^eta 1/H(x)dx, elapsed sincez20. CompositeGL16 and32 on every intersected donor interpolation segment. Saved proper_elapsed_s is diagnostic comparison only, not an exact identity for the interpolation quadrature.

source.physical_parameters: Reuse both MODEL_CONFIG sources and energy support[5,150]eV, exactly their temperatures/powers/cutoffs/amplitudes/envelope/escape fractions. Stellar fesc0.2 once; externalIGM fesc1; same-parcel RR not injected.
source.normalization: This isolated continuous-source projection target uses Z_cont=integral_5^150 raw(E)dE and s(E)=raw/Z_cont. ProductionZ uses GL64 on existing spectral split intervals; independentGL96 confirms. Separately compute exact oldGL2 quadrature Z_old and corresponding meanenergy; report Z_old/Z_cont and both meanenergies. Old config/results remain unchanged and finite-discrete target is not called identical to continuous target.
source.isotropy: Reflection-even normal-frame emission integrated over folded mu_b in[0,1] with total weight1; azimuth and opposite hemisphere already integrated, no extra2 or4pi factor.
source.excluded_source_tail: Birth energy outside[5,150] is zero by compact-model definition. Projection-domain missing support inside that model is a separate explicit tail ledger.

projection.Q: Q=c*|P| in eV for normalized reference covariant momentum P, nu=P_parallel/|P| folded[0,1]
projection.computational_form: Inner E bounds max(5,Qlo*R) to min(150,Qhi*R); outer multiplier1/(V R^3). Integrate s(E) and E*s(E) separately, never cell-center energy timesnumber. Empty intersections exactly0.
projection.angular_splits: Within each nu cell split wherever any finite positive Q boundary timesR equals5 or150. Skip Qedge0 since positive E cannot equal0*R. R^2=alpha+(beta-alpha)nu^2; solve nu^2=((Eedge/Qedge)^2-alpha)/(beta-alpha). At eta0 alpha=beta, no such angular splits. Only retain real interior cuts. Add native nu cell edges.
projection.projection_tail: Separate per-angular-bin Q>400 rates computed from birth-energy intersection E>400R up to150, with no infinite-range quadrature. LowerQ<0 tail identically0. Sum all cells plus tail equals q and q*mean_birth_energy.
projection.time_units: Per-proper-second columnsC_N,C_U; per-eta columns=C/H exactlyonce. Proper-volume columns=nHref*C with nHref in cm^-3. Physical comoving-volume columns=a_phys^3*nHref*C.

independent_reference.coordinates: Use normal-frame mu_b and E. D0=sqrt((1-mu_b^2)exp(-2b)+mu_b^2 exp(4b)); Q=E exp(eta)D0, nu=mu_b exp(2b)/D0. Map each covariant angular edge to birth mu using independent direct equations, then radial birth-energy intersection with Q edges. No production map/integrands/roots supplied to oracle.
independent_reference.quadrature: ReferenceGL48/96 in normal-frame angular coordinate and innerE, split angular domain at support intersections computed in that coordinate. ZreferenceGL96. Compare reference orders first; all outputs scaled by actual positive q or q*meanE. No nested adaptive integral required.
independent_reference.clock: Independent scipy.integrate.quad of1/H andq/H on every donor knot segment, epsabs0,epsrel2e-12,limit50. Integrand may share pinnedHinterpolant because this tests integration of that declared representation; no production GL routine reused. Report warning as HOLD.
independent_reference.source_totals: For eta endpoints snapshots, continuous count integral q/Hdeta and energy meanE*thatcount. These scalar totals are not claimed as temporally deposited per-cell histories.

source_JVP.amplitude: Column is linear in amplitudeA. Derivative dC/dA=C/A for current positiveA; more robust unit-amplitude column. Directionv=(0.3*A_stellar,-0.2*A_IGM) gives exact sum ofunitcolumns*v. Independent central finite difference delta=1e-4 onscaledamplitudes confirms.
source_JVP.gas_state: Derivative of prescribed source column with respect to all9ionicfractions is exactly0; no chemistry RHS/Jacobian evaluation. This does not certify coupled-opacity JVP.

frozen_validation.denominators: Actual positiveq orq*meanE, nevermax(1,q). Cellwise errors normalized to whole source rate so vanishing cells do not create fabricated floors. q0 source gives exactzeros; relativeerrorsundefined.
frozen_validation.cases: Exactly3snapshots*2sources on fixedgrid, GL32/64 and independent48/96; clock and integratedsource at3snapshots; readbackall201donorknotfields; geometrychecknu[0,.1,.5,.9,1],Q[5,30,150]; sourceadditivity; onezeroamplitude; onepairedamplitudeJVP; proper/comovingconversion identity; oldnormalizationcomparison; no sweeps.
frozen_validation.failure: Preserve costs/raw/source; targeted diagnosed repair only inremainingbudget; do not relax tolerances or silently enlarge fixtures/referenceorders.
